description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to build an adequate, efficient, safe and sustainable road network linking the Republic of Azerbaijan domestically and internationally. The Project shall consist of the following: i) construction of approximately 39.3 km of a new four-lane category I expressway between km 22.1 to km. 61.4 (the Project Road) on the Masalli-Astana highway, comprising: Section B of the Project Road from km 22.1 to km. 45.1 and Section C of the Project Road from km 45.1 to km 61.4; and ii) project management support and consulting services for construction supervision, financial audit, social and environmental assessments, and institutional capacity development.

title.narrative: Loan 2831: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024

Progress Toward Outcome: Final review mission fielded Aug 28-30 2017 to review the project's progress. Time-bound action plan agreed and closely monitored to ensure full project completion by loan closing date on 28 Sept 2017. As of Sept 22, section B is 100% completed.
A review mission was fielded on 1-9 March 2017 to review the implementation progress of ongoing road works and agree with the government a time-bond action plan to improve the portfolio performance.
As of 28 February 2017, physical progress reached about 70% with 11.1 km asphalt base and binder course completed and most of the road structure work (bridges and culverts) substantially completed. The last 2.8-km segment (with embankment and few drainage culverts completed so far) has been dropped from the project scope due to the change of border crossing location for the road corridor between Azerbaijan and Iran. AAY proposed to use the contract savings to rehabilitate the last 6.2 km of the existing road up to the current border crossing location. A contract variation in this regard is being processed.
Some results are in the Environmental and Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2018: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/39176/39176-043-emr-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Oct 2013: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//39176-043-aze-rp-03.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Section B contract was signed on 29 March 2013. The civil works for Section B (km 22.15-41.5) commenced on 18 June 2013 and has undergone three contract variations. The estimated completion date is 31 August 2017.
Due to changes in legislation in Azerbaijan which resulted in increased prices for fuel (diesel) and bitumen, adjustment to contract price was endorsed by ADB on 17 June 2016 at the request of "Azeravtoyol". As of 30 June 2017, physical progress is about 87% with 18.5 km section asphalt base and binder course and 17.0 km asphalt wearing course completed.
Section C contract was signed on 31 October 2013. The civil works for Section C (km 41.5-61.4) commenced on 27 January 2014 and has undergone three contract variations. Adjustment to contract price in lieu of increased prices for fuel (diesel) and bitumen due to changes in legislation in Azerbaijan was endorsed by ADB on 24 May 2016 at the request of "Azeravtoyol". The last 2.8-km segment (with embankment and few drainage culverts completed so far) has been dropped from the project scope due to the change of border crossing location for the road corridor between Azerbaijan and Iran. As a result, starting from the interchange at km 58.6, traffic will be diverted to the existing M3 highway up to the current border crossing point. As of 30 June 2017, about 14 km of asphalt works has been fully completed. The remaining works are at advance stage of implementation, and will be fully completed by 28 September 2017.
